relations.subject: Bezzenberger
relations.evidence: Benfey was a famous teacher, among whose students were e.g. Bezzenberger, Budenz, Bühler, Fick, P. Goldschmidt, Haug, Justi, L. Lange, Leo Meyer, Nöldeke, Peile, Senart, Wackernagel, and Zachariae.
